# Importations
```{r}
library(necountries)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# nimConstants
```{r}
simul.nimConstants = list(n.individuals = 1000, 
                           n.detected = 749,
                           n.detected1 = 750,
                           n.detectors = 6457,
                           n.years = 7,
                           n.years1 = 6,
                           n.covs = 3,
                           numHabWindows = 1802,
                           n.countries = 8,
                           y.maxDet = 25,
                           x.maxDet = 21,
                           ResizeFactor = 3,
                           n.cellsSparse = 244,
                           maxNBDets = 180,
                           nMaxDetectors = 6)
```

# nimInits
```{r}
simul.nimInits <- list(
  sxy = array(NA,
              dim = c(simul.nimConstants$n.individuals,
                      simul.nimConstants$n.years,
                      2)),
  dispSigma = 3,
  z = matrix(NA,
             ncol=simul.nimConstants$n.years,
             nrow=simul.nimConstants$n.individuals),
  omeg1 = c(0.5, 0.25, 0.25),
  gamma = c(0,0,0,0,0,0),
  p0 = matrix(NA,
              ncol=(simul.nimConstants$n.years+1),
              nrow=simul.nimConstants$n.years),
  sigma = 1.71,
  betaDens = 0.0361, # A choisir
  betaCovs = c(0.0712, 0.0813, 0.0592),
  betaResponse = -0.0386,
  h = c(0,0,0,0,0,0),
  w= c(0,0,0,0,0,0)
)
```
